full_judgment:
Syed Md Dastagir Husain J: This death reference is referred under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure by the Additional Sessions Judge, Lakshmipur for confirmation of the sentence to death of condemned prisoner Amir Hossain @ Shona Miah, Most. Halima Begum, Delwar Hossain @ Shohel, Abdul Matin, Md Montaz Uddin Ahmed and Abdul Khaleq Patowary and Criminal Appeal No. 687 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner/ appellant 1. Amir Hossain @ Shona Miah, 2. Most Halima Begum, 3. Delwar Hossain Shohel 4. Abdul Matin 5.Md Montaz Uddin. Ahmed 6. Abdul Jalil 7. Rasheda Begum and 8. Monawara Begum and Jail Appeal No. 141 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Montazuddin Ahmed, Jail Appeal No. 142 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Abdul Matin, Jail Appeal No. 143 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Amir Hossain, Jail Appeal No. 144 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Delower Hossain Sohel, Jail Appeal No. 145 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Halima Khatun, Jail Appeal No. 146 of 2007 preferred by the convict appellant A Jalil, Jail Appeal No. 147 of 2007 preferred by the convict appellant Rasheda Begum and Jail Appeal No. 148 of 2007 preferred by the convict appellant Monowara is directed against the Judgment and order dated 26-2-2007 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Lakshmipur in Sessions Case No. 19 of 1998 arising out of Lakshmipur Police Station case No. 5 dated 12-6-1994 corresponding to GR No. 162 of 1994 convicting the appellant Nos. 1 to 5 under section 302 and 114 of the Penal Code and sentencing them to death and further convicting the appellant Nos. 6 to 8 under section 302 and 114 of the Penal Code and sentencing them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Tk. 10,000 each in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for one year more.

2. The prosecution case as has been stated in the first Information Report lodged on 12-6-1994 by Md Abul Kalam the brother of the deceased stating inter alma that his youngest sister Faizunnessa aged about 26 years was given marriage with accused Amir Hossain about 5 years ago and they were blessed with a son named Fayez who is aged about 4 years. Accused Amir Hossain was serving at Saudi Arabia for about 12/13 years and Amir Hossain used to send his earning money to his elder brother Dalilur Rahman through his account but clever Dalilur Rahman did not spend all those money in favour of his family affairs rather he misappropriated all these money in favour of his family. Accused Amir Hossain while returning to his home after about 7/8 months ago demanded account of his money as sent by him and for that matter there were quarrel regularly. Deceased Faizunnessa was also involved in such altercation with his elder brother Dalilur Rahman and his wife Halima Khatun and his son Sohel, Manik, Monir Hossain and others and hence Faizunnessa was a target to them. In the circumstances they used to torture Faizunnessa and they tried to drive her out Dalilur Rahman, his wife and his son instigated to kill Faizunnessa. On 12-6-1994 at about 14-00 hours while Amir Hossain and his wife Faizunnessa were taking meal, started altercation and at one stage accused Amir closed the windows of their homestead and then started stabbing haphazardly with a dao causing grievous injuries and then Amir Hossain slaughtered his wife Faizunnessa and then fled away, Amir Hossain was then caught with the help of Matin and the local people and was presented before the Hazirpara Union Parishad. He has admitted his guilt of killing in presence of the local chairman, member and the witnesses. Police came and have taken appropriate action. The dead body of Faizunnessa was sent to morgue for post mortem and Amir Hossain was then taken to police Station. The informant was informed by the local people and then lodged this FIR.

3. The police after investigation on visiting the place of occurrence and on preparing the seizure list, examining the witnesses tinder section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure submitted charge sheet under sections 302/114 of the Penal Code against the appellants.

4. The case was then transferred to the Additional Sessions Judge, Lakshmipur for trial. The trial court after framing charge under section 302 and 114 of the Penal Code and on conclusion of the trial found guilty of the charge leveled against them and sentenced the appellants Nos. 1-5 to death and further sentenced the appellant Nos. 6 to 8 to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Taka 10,000 each and in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 1(one) year more.

5. A Khaleque who was also facing capital sentence was absconding during trial is represented by the State Defence Lawyer Mrs Hasna Begum. The defence pleaded not guilty, he is innocent, falsely implicated in connection with the alleged murder and, as such, he is to be acquitted from the charges leveled against him.

6. Mr Golam Mohammad Dulal, the learned advocate representing all the accused excluding A Khaleque who was absconding submitted that the conviction and sentence passed by the trial court is without any basis. The place of occurrence has yet to be established, contradictory statement made by the PWs even the informant himself contradicted in his statement with the FIR lodged by him. Further he submits that the allegation as to chopping by the husband at 2-O'clock after taking meal is yet to be established moreover the post mortem report shows that the stomach was empty. Under the facts and circumstances the conviction and sentence passed by the court below is to be interfered by this court and it is liable to be set aside. He has referred 41 DLR (AD) 157 that the inconsistent statement made by PW 1 and the confessional statement made by the appellant which changed the version and FIR thereby they are required to be acquitted. Further in the same decision it has been stated that the confessional statement since not being placed before the accused while he was examined under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure renders infirmity of the judgment and, as such, they are to be acquitted from the charges leveled against them. He also referred a decision reported in 54 DLR (AD) 60 that incriminating evidence or circumstances sought to be proved by the prosecution must be put to the accused during examination under section 342 CrPC otherwise it would cause miscarriage of justice.

7. And also referred 7 ADC 445 that the circumstances as to the guilt has not been satisfied and, as such, they are to be acquitted.

8. On the other hand the learned Deputy Attorney-General submits that the appellant Amir Hossain is the husband of the deceased and he is to explain how his wife expired. In his confessional statement he has categorically stated how the heinous crime was committed and nature of killing. The victim expired at the residence of her husband. The statement of appellant Amir Hossain and FIR also corroborates with each other. The incriminating article dao was seized and, as such, the conviction and sentence is to be upheld. Further he has referred a decision reported in 16 BLD (AD) 293 = 2 BLC (AD) 27 that although the trial court should draw the attention to the accused particularly confessional statement while examining him under section 342 and mere omission on the part of the trial of the accused of his confessional statement does not always affect its cause. Further he has referred 63 DLR (AD) 105 that the procedural defect if not held to be cured and the accused are acquitted in such case great injustice would bring before the court of justice. Under such circumstances the trial court did not commit any wrong in convicting the accused appellant as such the conviction and sentence is to be affirmed.

9. Now let us analyse the depositions made by the prosecution witnesses.

10. PW 1 Abul Kalam who is also the informant in this particular case. In his examination in chief stated that the victim Faizunnessa is his sister who was given marriage with Amir Hossain about 5 years ago and she has one son within their wedlock. The son of the victim is now staying with them. He is from Ballavpur and the accuseds are from Indropur village. Further in his examination in chief stated that he received information at 1-30/2-00 pm on 12-6-1996 that accused Amir Hossain has killed his wife and such information he heard from people of Chandragonj Bazar. He then went to the place of occurrence. The house of Amir Hossain is the place of occurrence and it situates at Indropur village. The homestead of accused Amir Hossain was closed while people saw the dead body of his sister Faizunnessa through the window. She is being slaughtered and also found injuries on different parts of her body. The he left for his house. He found Foiz Ahmed the son of Faizunnessa was crying. He did not find any of the accuseds at the place of occurrence. The door of the room was closed. Dalilur Rahman and his family fled away from the place of occurrence with his cows and goods. He then again came to the place of occurrence with his mother and sisters, Sohel son of Dalil brother of accused Amir Hossain and A. Matin maternal uncle of Sohel took Amir Hossain to the Board Office. People at the place of occurrence was talking that there was dispute with regard to money with Amir Hossain and Dalilur Rahman. One week ago from the date of occurrence Halima Khatun wife of Dalil chopped his sister Faizunnessa for monitory reason. On the date of occurrence Amir Hossain took Faizunnessa to the doctor. For monitory reason accused Dalil, Halima, Humayun, Sohel, Matin slaughtered Faizunnessa. Matin is his cousin brother. A few days ago of the occurrence Matin threatened his mother that Faizunnessa will be slaughtered even if Taka 20,000 is required to be spent. Hasan Raza worker of Dalil told him on the date of occurrence that while he went to the house of Amir Hossain wife of Dalil, Halima told to go out as wife of Amir Hossain is to give birth. Thereafter Hasan Raza while went to hours of Amir Hossain came to know that Faizunnessa was slaughtered. On the date of occurrence his mother brought some goods through his brother Karim and he went to local board office before Magrib prayer while Yousuf police came there. Police came to the place of occurrence and then prepared inquest report. Police has also taken his oral statement. The dead body was then sent to Laxmipur. He then came to Laxmipur Police Station. While he was interrogated, he said about accused Dalil, Halima, Sohel, Abdul Matin. The police has taken his signature in the form and asked him to come on the following day. He saw accused Momtaz Uddin and Sayed Chairman present at the place of occurrence on Monday. Then Noor Mohammad asked Bamon Muhuri to write the ejahar. The ejahar was read over to him and then came to know that Dalil, Halima and Amir Hossain was made accuseds. While he asked the police why Amir was made accused then police said that Amir was made accused as per instruction of the chairman. The copy of the ejahar while he asked for, the police said that at the moment it is not available and to come after 2 days. Then he came to know that only Amir Hossain was made accused and no other was made accused, While he asked the reasons then the police has given a letter to hand it over to chairman. The ejahar is Exhibit-1 and the signature is Exhibit- 1/1. The letter dated 15-6-1994 is also Exhibited which is Exhibit No. 2. The police has taken the signature in the inquest report. Since the name of other accuseds were not mentioned in the ejahar as such he went to CID. CID then came to the place of occurrence and investigated the matter and thereafter submitted charge sheet. He was taken to Magistrate by the CID Inspector while he made his statement. The statement is Exhibit-3 which he made on 1-11-1994 before the Magistrate and the signature is Exhibit 3/1. Deceased Faizunnessa was pregnant for 6/7 months at the time of occurrence. In cross examination on behalf of Dalilur Rahman, Halima Begum, Delower Hossain alias Sohel, A Matin, A Jalil, Monowara Begum, he has stated that his house is one mile away from the house of deceased sister. Accused Amir Hossain is his brother-in-law. There is houses of his sister and Dalilur Rahman in the East South corner of the pond. The house of his sister and Dalilur Rahman situates and there are 8/9 houses on the west of the pond. On the west bank of pond the house of Jamil and Khalil situates and besides them the house of Momtaz, Khaleque, Ledu, Sattar, Dulal, Jahir and Abu Miah situates. The shop room situates at Andarghar. Accused Dalil and Halima are the husband and wife and the son is accused Sohel. Accused Jamil and Monowara are the husband and wife. Accused Dalil, Jamil and Amir Hossain are the full brothers. Accused Matin is the brother in law of accused Dalil and also his cousin brother. While Amir Hossain married his sister she was taken to the house of accused brother Dalil and after marriage Amir left for Saudi Arabia. After the marriage his sister used to stay in their house and used to come with the son and daughters of Daliluddin. About 7/8 months ago of the occurrence Amir Hossain came from Sadui Arabia, Amir started construction of the house where his sister was killed. The house of Amir situates 10/15 cubits to the south of the house of accused Dalil. He could not remember from whom he heard about the occurrence. While he came to the place of occurrence along with his mother and sister accused Dalil, wife of Jamil, son, wife of Montaz, Gafur Madbor, Latu, Nurullah Patwary told him that out of monitory transaction accused Dalil, Halima, Sohel, Matin, Humayun killed his sister but they did not say about the killing of his sister. He saw his sister slaughtered through the window which is south to the room. Though the window of east to the door was opened and no one was inside the room.

11. Further in cross examination he has stated that he is not accused No. 1 in CR Case No. 229 of 1994. The window of south was opened but the door was closed and his brother in law Amir Hossain was separated from Dalilur Rahman 7/8 months to the goods in between Dalilur Rahman and Amir Hossain. The persons present did not say to him that who has killed his sister. Witness Monira Begum is his mother and witness Luky is his wife, witness Hason Raza is his neighbour, witness A Karim is his younger brother. Witness Latu Miah is east to his house. He does not know where about of the house of A Malek also he does not know witness Shah Alam Chowdhury and Siddiqullah. Hanif Ullah is the U.P member of Hazir Para. He did not lodge the ejahar on the night of occurrence. Police has taken a signature in a Form. He did not see the killing of his sister by his own eyes and did not say different things at the instigation of the people at different times. He denied that he has lodged the F.I.R. but made statement in a different form with CID. Police made only one accused by changing the names. Cross on behalf of accused Montazuddin and Rasheda Begum, he stated that he knows personally accused Montaz Uddin who lives at Dhaka. He has contested in the post of Chairman of Hazirpara union, Rasheda Begum is his wife. He did not make Montaz Uddin and Rasheda an accused. They were made witnesses in this case. On the following day of the occurrence he saw Montazuddin and chairman at the police station. Cross on behalf of accused Amir Hossain, he stated that he does not know how to read or write. Further stated that Bashu Muhury has written the ejahar. He did not state to write down the name of Amir Hossain and Md Khaleque. He also did not state to the Magistrate while recorded his statement about Amir Hossain and Khaleque as accused. Amir used to send money to the account of Dalilur Rahman. While he resides outside of the country Halima a few days ago has beaten his sister regarding sending money from foreign country and it is known to wife of Montazuddin. A Matin while threatened his sister to be killed at that time his mother was present. He saw son of Amir Hossain at 150/200 cubits west from the place of occurrence. At that time his age was 4/5 years. He saw Amir Hossain at Board Office in an injured condition. The relationship in between his sister and Amir Hossain was very good.

12. PW 2 Md Nurullah, in his examination in chief stated that the occurrence took place on 12-6-1994. At that time he was at his house. Then he heard that there is a murder at Andarper and then he went there and saw people are looking through the window of a room where Foizunnessa wife of Amir Hossain was lying in a murdered position. He also has seen murdered Foizunnessa through the window. She was in an injured position. On query he came to know that due to monitory transaction with Dalil and Amir. Halima and Sohel killed Foizunnessa. He came to know the name of the accused from Akbor, Khaleque, Jalil, Gafur, Montaz and others as they were present at that time. One week before the occurrence accused Jalil chopped Foizunnessa for monitory transaction. Amir Hossain wanted to file a case but Montaz resisted the same that he will mitigate the matter. Police prepared the inquest report in his presence and he signed as witness. Accused Daliler Rahman, Halima, Sohel, Montaz are in the dock. Police interrogated him during investigation. There will be no cross on behalf of accused Jalil and Monowara. Cross on behalf of accused Dalil, A. Matin, Sohel and Halima, he has stated that the informant is his cousin brother and they are of the same house. Foizunnessa is his cousin sister. There was no eye witnesses as to who has killed Foizunnessa. He came to the place of occurrence on getting information from public and that was not stated to the police but he kept silent. He also did not state to the police about chopping of Foizunnessa about one week ago of the occurrence. The window of southern side was opened on the date of occurrence. He denied that there was no window on the southern side and it was not opened. On the following day of the occurrence he made his statement. He along with Nur Mohammad, Abul Kalam the informant made their statement at the police station. At that time Montaz was sitting at the police station. He has stated to the police about the killing from whom he heard about the occurrence but he could not say whether the police has recorded the name. He denied that he stated falsely. In further cross examination on behalf of Montaz and Rasheda, he stated that he knows personally Montaz Uddin. Rasheda is the wife of Montazuddin. Montazuddin contested in the UP election and he contested against chairman Sayed. Montazuddin and Rasheda are involved with the occurrence and he did not state anything about Montaz and Rasheda with the police. Cross on behalf of accused A. Khaleque and Amir Hossain, he stated that he was presented at the police station along with the informant while lodging F.I.R. The informant did not state to the police the name of Amir Hossain as an accused. He does not remember whether name of Khaleque was told to the police. No one has stated about A. Khaleque and Amir Hossain to him. Before one week of the occurrence Montaz did not compromise the matter with regard to chopping on Foizunnessa. Amir was caught from Chandragonj Bazar. Matin, Sohel brought Amir Hossain to Board Office at Hazirpara. Amir Hossain was beaten. He saw Amir Hossain at Hazirpara. There was no sign of injury upon Amir Hossain. There exists good relationships in between Amir Hossain and Foizunnessa as husband and wife.

13. PW 3 Md Hasanuzzaman alias Hason Raza, in his examination in chief stated that the occurrence took place on 12-6-1994, Sunday. At that time he was working in the landed property of accused Dalil. After finishing work at 1-30 noon he went to the house of Dalil along with grass. Wife of Dalil asked him to keep those grass near the cowshed. Wife of Dalil was in the room of Amir Hossain. On his inquiry wife of Dalil told him that wife of Amir is in delivery position. Then he saw Sohel coming out from the room of Amir Hossain and Dalil and Montaz were going to their house from the house of occurrence. Dalil was then standing in the west to the room of Dalil. Then he came back to his house. At 3-00/3-30 pm on way to bazaar he went to the place of occurrence and saw brother of informant A. Karim is lying in the court yard of Amir Hossain and also saw Latu and Soelman. Present persons told that wife of Amir Hossain is being slaughtered. He made statement with the CID Inspector. Accused Dalil and his wife, Sohel, Montaz are in the dock. He did not find any accused at the place of occurrence. Cross on behalf of accused Dalil and Monowar, he stated that accused Jalil, Dalil and Amir Hossain are the full brothers. Jalil and his wife lives in a separate house. He did not see any fighting and cutting while Jalil and Montaz went towards their house but he saw Jalil. Cross on behalf of accused Dalil and others, he has stated that he did not see the occurrence and also denied that he did not work as worker in the agricultural land of Dalil. Dalil did not work as farmer and he is deposing at the instigation of the informant. Cross on behalf of accused Amir Hossain and A. Khaleque, he stated that he did not find Amir Hossain and A Khaleque at the place of occurrence and he could not say the relationship in between Amir Hossain and his wife.

14. PW 4 Nur Mohammad, in his examination in chief stated that the occurrence took place on 12-6-1994. He went to Chandragonj Bazzar at 1-O'clock at noon. He heard that there is a murder at Andarpar. At 3-30 pm he came to Andarpar and then he went to the house of Amir Hossain. Dalilur Rahman, Montaz, Gafur said that Dalilur Rahman, Halima, Sohel, Humayun, Motin fled away after the killing. Dalilur Rahman then stated that they did not flee as they did not kill. Then he saw wife of Amir Hossain in a bleeding condition in the room. He heard before the occurrence that Amir Hossain used to send money to Dalil and out of that money there was dispute arose with them and Halima Begum caused injury upon the victim. He heard that murder occurred due to dispute about the money. He was present at the time of preparation of inquest report and he has signed. He went to the police station while the informant went to lodge FIR. Two signatures of the informant were taken in a blank paper. On the following day he went to the police station along with informant. Then he brought Bashu Muhuri as per instruction of the police. Bashu Muhuri then has written the ejahar. Informant then made Dalilur Rahman, Halima Begum, Sohel, Motin, Humayun as accuseds in the ejahar. The police did not supply the copy of that ejahar. After 3 days while he received the ejahar then found that only Amir Hossain was made an accused in this case. The police handed over a paper to the chairman through them. Thereafter he made an application with the CID. Accused were present on the dock. No cross was on behalf of accused Jalil and Monowara. Cross on behalf of accused Dalil and others, he has stated that he saw the dead body of wife of Amir Hossain through south window. There was also a door on the southern portion of the room. Jalil himself told that accused Dalil, Halima, Sohel, Motin have killed wife of Amir Hossain. The persons did not say actually who has committed murder. After 13th he did not make any statement with the police. The informant is not his relation and he denied that under obligation on behalf of the informant he made false statement. Cross on behalf of Amir Hossain and A. Khaleque, he has stated that while he went at the place of occurrence, he did not find accused Amir Hssain and A. Khaleque. He knows the wife of Amir Hossain. He had good relationship with the wife of Amir Hossain.

15. PW 5 Siraj Miah, in his examination in chief stated that the occurrence took place about 4/5 days ago. He could not remember the date of occurrence. He heard that the wife of Sona Miah was killed but could not say who has actually killed. He heard after one day of the occurrence. He did not make any statement with the police. He was declared hostile. He did never go to the house of the accused. He knows the accused as they are of his area. He does not know whether accused Amir Hossain used to send money from foreign country. He does not know whether the informant has filed any statement. No cross was made on behalf of the accused.

16. PW 6 Latu Miah, who is aged about 50 years stated that Occurrence held on 12.6.1994 and he heard that murder was committed at Chandragonj under Andarghar. Wife of Amir Hossain alias Sona was murdered at her room. He saw the dead body at 3-O'clock and saw the dead body at her house. He heard that brother of Amir Hossain, son of his brother, brother in law of his brother and wife of his brother have slaughtered the wife of Amir Hossain and chopped her to death. While he went then he saw Dalil brother of Amir Hossain, Sohel son of Dalil, accused Motin, accused Halima Begum going on foot towards east. Many people were present at the place of occurrence. Cross on behalf of accused Dalilur Rahman, Halima Begum, Delower, A. Motin, he stated that his house is half k.m. away from the house of informant Abul Kalam. He denied that the informant is not his relation. His house is one and half k.m. away from the house of the accused. Accused are not his relations. Before the occurrence he never went to the house of accused. There were two rooms at the place of occurrence. One room is on the southern viti and another is on the northern viti. The accused used to stay to the south. He could not say how many brothers have Amir Hossain and also could not say how many sons and daughters they have. He saw 50/60 persons at the occurrence. He knows Karim and Hason Raza out of those persons. He could not say from whom he heard about the occurrence. He denied that he did not hear about the killing of the wife of Amir Hossain by his brother, wife of his brother, son of his brother and brother in law of his brother. He denied that he made false statement. Cross on behalf of accused Monowara and Abdul Jalil, he has stated that he does not know all the brothers of Amir Hossain also he does not know accused Monowara and Abdul Jalil. They did not stay in the house of the occurrence. He did not hear that the accuseds have killed the wife of Amir Hossain. Cross on behalf of accused Montaz and Rasheda Begum he stated that he did not hear that these accuseds were involved with the occurrence. Cross on behalf of accused Amir Hossain and A. Khaleque by the State Defence, he stated that he knows A Khaleque. He did not find A Khaleque and Amir Hossain at the place of occurrence. Before such occurrence Amir Hossain used to reside at foreign country. He did not hear that these accuseds have killed the victim.

17. PW 7 Shah Alam Chowdhury, in his examination in chief stated that he is aged about 75 years. He does not know the date of occurrence. He heard that wife of Amir Hossain was killed. He did not go to the place of occurrence. He also did not hear who has killed. Police did not interrogate him. He was declared hostile and then cross examined by the State. In his cross examination he has stated that he made his statement at the CID Police Camp at Laxmipur. On the date of occurrence he has taken tea in the tea stall of Harun at Chandragonj under Andarghar. Accused Dalilur Rahman called him and he denied that wife of Amir Hossain was killed in his house. He denied that Amir Hossain and Dalilur Rahman are full brothers. He denied that Amir Hossain was caught at Chandragonj Bazaar and dispute arose out of monitory transaction and wife of Dalilur Rahman has beaten wife of Amir Hossain due to dispute. He denied that Dalilur Rahman and his family members have killed wife of Amir Hossain and he deposed falsely. Cross on behalf of accused Dalilur Rahman, Halima Begum, Delower and A Matin, he has stated that the place of occurrence is 500 cubits away from Andarghar. He heard hue and cry and at that time Dalilur Rahman was with him. Cross on behalf of accused Jalil, Monowara, Montaz Uddin and Rashida was declined. Cross by the State Defence on behalf of Amir Hossain and A. Khaleque, he stated that he did not hear about the killing the wife of Amir Hossain.

18. PW 8 Lucky Begum, in her examination in chief stated that occurrence took place on Sunday, 12-6-1994. He heard about the occurrence in the afternoon. Deceased Foizer Nessa is her sister-in-law and occurrence took place in the house of her husband. She was at the house of her husband. She was sick due to birth of a child. She heard from the people. On the date of occurrence her mother-in-law Monira Begum sent Karim her brother-in-law to the house of the deceased Foizunnessa with, coconut and food for chicken. She further stated that Karim while entering into the house of deceased Foizunnessa, he saw accused Halima, Dalilur Rahman, Motin coming out from the room of deceased Foizunnessa with a blood stained dao and cheni. Then he asked for his sister (Bubu) while son of Dalilur Rahman closed the door from inside and while Karim was rebuked, Karim then became senseless and then came fell down. Thereafter Karim was taken to doctor. This story she heard from Karim on the following day of the occurrence. Mother of Babul, her mother in law and her husband along with others went to the house of the occurrence. She heard from them that those accused have killed Foizunnessa. Her sister- in -law Foizunnessa was killed on the date of occurrence at 2-0' clock noon. While she was interrogated by the police she said that dispute arose 8/9 days ago about the monitory transaction as money was sent from foreign by the husband of Foizunnessa and Foizunnessa was beaten out of that dispute. Cross on behalf of accused Jalil, Monowara, Montaz Uddin and Rashid was declined. Cross by the State Defence on behalf of accused Amir Hossain and A. Khaleque, she has stated that she heard about the occurrence but did not see. She further stated that deceased Foizunnessa have good relationship with accused Amir Hossain. Amir Hossain was not found in the house of the occurrence. Cross on behalf of accused Dalilur Rahman, Halima Begum, Delower, Abdul Matin, she has stated that her house is 2 miles away from the house of the occurrence. He did not see personally about the occurrence. Further stated that Karim met with her husband after one day of the occurrence and stated Karim might have seen the chopping upon Foizunnessa. She denied that Karim did not state anything about the occurrence. The informant is her husband. She further denied that as per instruction of her husband she made false statement.

19. PW 9 Md A Karim, in his examination in chief stated that he went to the house of his sister Foizunnessa at Shibpur with 8 kg food for chicken, one pair of coconut on 12-6-1994 at 2- O'clock and found that the door of accused Dalil was opened and the door of Foizunnessa his sister was closed. He heard about fighting inside the room of his sister. He then called his sister as bubu but did not get any sound. Then he went to the west of the room and then southern door opened and then accused Halima Khatun came out with a cheni through that door. Accused Dalil also came out. Accused Motin with blood stained dao came out of that room. Accused Sohel alias Delower by closing the door on the south jumped out of the wall. He became senseless on seeing the blood stained dao, cheni and daggar. Then he was taken to doctor Khokon and his sense came after 2 days. <u>39. From reading of the FIR and the confessional statement made by the accused, it appears that accused Amir Hossain has killed his wife. His killing as it appears from his confessional statement that while his scrotum was pressed he then started beating chopping with dao. Then it is not premeditation but out of danger, he then started beating. Further it appears that there is no eye witness in this particular case. But this accused Amir Hossain is the husband and she expired in the house of her husband and husband is to explain how his wife expired. In the FIR as it appears that there was a talk of transaction of money with Dalilur Rahman but in deposition no one has said about such transaction of money. No witnesses have stated about A Jalil, Rasheda and Monowara though they are facing life sentence. Further it appears that A Khaleque Patwary was absconding after getting bail on 11-6-2002. PW 1 also did not say anything about Khaleque, PW 1 also did not say anything about accused Amir Hossain while he was deposing as witness. The statement made by PW 1 while deposing before the court and the statement as made in the FIR by the same PW 1 is contradictory. From 164 statement it appears that after taking their meal in the afternoon there was the killing. Thereby the deceased is to be contained in a full stomach but post mortem report shows that her stomach was empty. Food was taken at about 1-30 PM and she expired at 2-O'clock. While Amir Hossain was chopping his wife other accused Dalilur Rahman, Khaleque, Montaz and Halima caught hold of his wife. The rest were guarding out side of the room. Why then the rest accused chased him for which he has to go to Chandragonj from where he was arrested. If anybody supports him or any one instigate him to kill his wife then why again they were chasing him. Moreover doctor found the stomach empty just after half an hour of taking meal. The confessional statement and the statement made by PW 1 is contradictory. If we want to rely on confessional statement then the statement of PW 1 falls. Prosecution is supposed to examine 35 witnesses which is found to be absent in this case. Moreover this confessional statement was not placed before the accused while he was examined under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. Since the prosecution could not clarify the position of the death of the victim as it contradicts with the depositions of PW 1 who was the informant and the confessional statement made by the accused. Thus it rest upon the evidences of other witnesses but other witnesses also did not support the prosecution case as to the place of occurrence even. The place of occurrence as has been stated in the FIR is the room of Amir Hossain but this appellant was found to be at bazaar from where he was apprehended. The sketch map does not show the place of occurrence and also the sketch map was not proved and exhibited. There is no recovery of dagger and knife. If the confessional statement is true and voluntary only then we can accept such statements but if it contradicts with the statement of the PWs then we have no other alternative but to reject the Death Reference as it changed the version in the court and it differ from the FIR thereby it shattered the prosecution case and we also get support as per decision reported in 41 DLR (AD) 157.</u>

40. The learned Assistant Attorney-General though have placed the case reported in 63 DLR (AD) 105 that in case of procedural defect which caused non application of the mind of the trial judge therefore it should go on remand. But in this particular case it appears that the statement of the PW 1 contradicts with the FIR and also with the confessional statement made by the accused himself. Therefore we do not feel it necessary to send it back on remand rather on such contradictory statement and also on the findings by the doctor as stomach found to be empty; we have no other alternative but to acquit the accused. Accordingly the Death Reference is rejected and connected Criminal Appeal and the Jail Appeals are allowed.
